observations: A large cardboard box for a Hisense chest freezer is shown on a metal cart in an outdoor street setting.
The brand 'Hisense' and the words 'CHEST FREEZER' are clearly printed on the box in photo 0.
A shipping label on the side of the box in photo 0 shows the model number 'FC-91DD'.
The box is secured with white plastic straps and appears to be factory-sealed.
The text 'ROMZY ELECTRONICS' is overlaid on the image.
The seller's text claims a 702-liter capacity and double doors.

claims.evidence: The box is closed; the internal configuration cannot be seen.
The capacity text on the label is not legible, although the model FC-91DD typically corresponds to this size.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual freezer outside the box or with the lid open.

risks.risk: The unit may have hidden physical damage from transport.
risks.proof: Photos of the freezer from all four sides and the top once unboxed.

risks.risk: The cooling system may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in, the compressor running, and the internal temperature dropping.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual freezer outside of the box.
Photo of the freezer with the doors open to verify the interior condition and double-door claim.
Clear photo of the technical specification plate on the back of the unit.
Video of the unit powered on and cooling.
response.reason: Only the external packaging is visible. In a remote transaction, a photo of a box is not sufficient proof of the item's existence, model, or condition.
